widget.how_body: Customer reviews, including product star ratings, help other shoppers learn more about the product and decide whether it is right for them. Ratings are calculated from genuine customer reviews. Reviews are checked before publication, and purchases are verified whenever possible.

brand_page.method_title: How we collect and moderate reviews
brand_page.method_p1: Reviews are collected on our store from customers, with purchases verified against orders, and imported from the review platform we used previously. Every submission is moderated before publication: we reject spam and abuse, but we never edit ratings or review text, and critical reviews are published alongside positive ones.
